reason_records.summary: The update reaches a real repository path through FastAPI/Starlette TestClient, and HTTPX removed an argument used by older Starlette versions.
A compatible FastAPI/Starlette line existed, making an unconditional block disproportionate, but the exact historical environment is missing.
The successful Docker job did not run the relevant Python tests; those tests were skipped by the workflow path filter.

material_limitations: Private maintainer checks and rationale unknown.
Static search cannot prove complete dynamic absence.
unresolved_questions: Do Ruff and route tests pass on the frozen head under a captured resolution?
Which exact FastAPI/Starlette versions resolve in the trusted rerun?

targeted_checks.name: capture_resolved_versions
targeted_checks.purpose: Record the exact environment used for behavioral evidence.
targeted_checks.suggested_action: After installing the frozen requirements in a trusted isolated checkout, preserve `python -m pip freeze` or an equivalent complete resolver report.

targeted_checks.name: ruff_check
targeted_checks.purpose: Run the repository's configured lint responsibility on the exact head.

targeted_checks.name: pytest_cov
targeted_checks.purpose: Exercise TestClient initialization and the route tests under HTTPX 0.28.1.

why_stronger_outcome_unjustified: Immediate merge would treat likely compatibility and unrelated/partial green CI as direct behavioral proof.
why_weaker_outcome_unjustified: Tagged framework evidence establishes a compatible branch and one resolution installed successfully, so indefinite block or abstention is disproportionate before the focused tests.
human_judgment_required: Authorize and run trusted exact-head checks.
Review residual risk and dependency hygiene.
Make the final merge or block decision.

transitions.condition: All targeted checks pass under a captured exact-head resolution.
TestClient initialization or route tests fail due to the HTTPX/Starlette interface.
transitions.next_action: Upgrade FastAPI/Starlette to a fixed line or retain HTTPX <0.28 while resolving compatibility.
Preserve unresolved state; do not upgrade confidence.

transitions.condition: Head revision, dependency constraints, or resolved environment changes.
transitions.next_action: Do not silently reuse this decision.
